answer: Deployment bias occurs when an AI model is used in ways not intended by its developers, leading to emergent bias where the model is applied in unanticipated contexts. It is important to address deployment bias because it can result in the misapplication of algorithms, which may lead to unfair outcomes and reinforce existing biases. Ensuring that AI systems are used as intended helps maintain their integrity and effectiveness, ultimately supporting fairness in automated scoring for writing and speaking assessments.
